label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y cubrió la nube la tienda de reunión, y la gloria de Jehová llenó el mishkán.
spanish: Y la nube cubrió tienda de reunión, y la gloria de Jehová llenó el tabernáculo.
grammarChanges: Replaced untranslated loanword 'mishkán' with the Spanish common noun 'tabernáculo' for הַמִּשְׁכָּן (H4908), which carries no proper-name marking in the tokens.

Removed the definite article from 'la tienda de reunión' because the construct אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד has no article in the tokens, and reordered to 'la nube cubrió tienda de reunión' (subject before verb) so the now-anarthrous object reads clearly in Spanish; no participant or meaning changed.
readerNote: Reordered subject and verb so the anarthrous 'tienda de reunión' (no article in the source) would not read ambiguously against the verb.
